title: A measured independent-output partition was missing from the callable squared-distance tactics

observation: The R128 K256 N32 confirmed candidate keeps full K resident but partitions N into groups of four, preserving FP32 difference-before-square. Its fresh paired medians are 15.36/4.608 us against the fixed K64 loop, speedup 3.3333x. The callable tactic only tiled K, leaving this independent-output mechanism to manual construction.
